description: This file contains CSS variables and styles for managing themes (light and dark) in the application, alongside styles for various components like the App, App-header, and theme-toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with styles for text alignment, background color, and color transition.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header component styles including background color, minimum height, and flexbox layout for centering elements.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button styles for theme toggling including positioning, background color, text color, and transition effects.
